en.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security takes the top spot on results that two independent labs document directly, not self-reported claims. AV-Comparatives' 2025 Summary Report lists it as a Top-Rated Product with Silver in Real-World Protection, Bronze in Malware Protection and Gold in Advanced Threat Protection, and AV-TEST's June 2026 Windows cycle gave it a perfect 6/6/6 for protection, performance and usability with a Top Product rating. At $59.99 for the first year across five devices, it beats Norton's headline price while matching or beating it on verified protection. The one real flaw is the bundled VPN, capped at 200MB a day per device, which is a rounding error for anyone who actually uses a VPN daily.

ESET HOME Security Essential takes second, and it is the only product in this list that has actually won AV-Comparatives' Product of the Year award outright, in 2024, with the same underlying engine posting a 6/6/6 Top Product score from AV-TEST in June 2026. The tradeoff is real: Essential skips the VPN and identity monitoring that live in ESET's pricier Premium and Ultimate tiers, so budget buyers get a genuinely top-rated engine and nothing else.

Norton 360 Deluxe has the richest feature set here, an unrestricted VPN, 50GB of Windows cloud backup, dark web monitoring and AI-driven scam detection, but it is also the one vendor that discloses its second-year price plainly: $124.99, up from a $49.99 first-year rate. I give it credit for the honesty and still dock it hard on real cost, because a renewal that runs two and a half times the intro price is the exact bait-and-switch this ranking exists to expose.

Microsoft Defender earns fourth for a simple reason: it is free, it is already installed, and AV-TEST's June 2026 run gave it a 6/5.5/6 with a Top Product rating. What you do not get is a VPN, a password manager, or parental controls, and the free tier stops at Windows.

Kaspersky Premium sits last, and not because of its engine. The US Commerce Department's prohibition took full effect on September 29, 2024, and remains in force through 2026: no new sales agreements, no signature updates, no legitimate support for American buyers. A security product that cannot legally update itself in your country has stopped functioning as a security product.

highlights.title: Bitdefender's medals are independently documented, not self-reported
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives' 2025 Summary Report gave Bitdefender a Top-Rated Product award with Silver in Real-World Protection, Bronze in Malware Protection, Gold in Advanced Threat Protection (shared with ESET) and Bronze in False Positives, and AV-TEST's June 2026 Windows cycle backed that up with a perfect 6/6/6 and a Top Product rating. That is two labs with no stake in which vendor wins, agreeing within the same year. The one place Bitdefender pulls back is the bundled VPN, which caps at 200MB per device per day, so treat it as a spot-check tool, not an always-on connection.

highlights.title: ESET is the only outright Product of the Year winner in this list
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives' Product of the Year award went to ESET HOME Security Essential in 2024, not a shared or category-specific medal but the top overall prize, and the same detection engine (tested as ESET Security Ultimate) posted a 6/6/6 Top Product score from AV-TEST in June 2026. What Essential leaves out matters too: the unlimited VPN and identity monitoring only show up once you step up to Premium or Ultimate, so this is the right pick for someone who wants a verified top-tier engine and is willing to shop separately for a VPN.

highlights.title: Norton discloses its renewal price, and the number is still the worst in this list
highlights.body: Most vendors here keep second-year pricing off the page entirely, which forces buyers to find out at the credit card statement. Norton does not do that: the $124.99 renewal for 360 Deluxe sits right on the product page next to the $49.99 first-year rate. I score that transparency as a genuine point in Norton's favor, and I still rank the real cost low, because a subscription that jumps 2.5x the moment the promotional period ends is a bad deal even when you saw it coming.

highlights.title: McAfee's unlimited-device VPN has a catch buried in the terms
highlights.body: McAfee+ Premium leads with the lowest first-year price in this list and coverage for an unlimited number of devices, both genuinely good numbers. The catch, confirmed by McAfee's own account pages, is that the bundled VPN's unlimited data only stays active while auto-renewal is turned on; switch it off to dodge the second-year price jump and the VPN quietly drops to 500MB a month. That is a design choice that punishes the exact behavior, cancelling a subscription, that a security-conscious buyer should feel free to do.

highlights.title: Kaspersky's US ban is the fact that overrides every spec sheet
highlights.body: The US Commerce Department's prohibition on Kaspersky took full effect September 29, 2024, and as of this ranking remains in force: no new sales agreements, no virus definition updates, and no legitimate resale or support for US customers. Kaspersky's detection engine has a long, technically strong track record, but a security product that cannot legally receive current threat signatures in your country has stopped functioning as a security product, regardless of what a lab measured before the ban took effect. For US readers, this is not one factor among several, it is disqualifying.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security 拿下第一，靠的是獨立驗證過的成績，廠商自己講的話不算數。AV-Comparatives 2025 年報告把它列進 Top-Rated Product，實測防護拿銀牌、惡意程式防護拿銅牌、進階威脅防護拿金牌，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月的 Windows 測試也給了滿分 6/6/6 加最佳產品評價。首年 59.99 美元罩五台裝置，價格比 Norton 的招牌價還低，防護實力卻打平甚至更好。唯一縮手的地方是內建 VPN，每台裝置每天只給 200MB，當成應急工具就好，別指望拿它常態掛著用。

ESET HOME Security Essential 排第二，而且是這份榜單裡唯一真正拿下 AV-Comparatives 年度產品大獎的一款，得獎年份是 2024 年，同一套偵測引擎（測試名稱為 ESET Security Ultimate）在 AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月也拿到滿分 6/6/6 最佳產品。不過 Essential 少的東西也是真的少，無限流量 VPN 跟身分監控要升到比較貴的 Premium 或 Ultimate 才有，如果你要的是驗證過的頂級引擎，VPN 另外找別家，這層剛好對。

Norton 360 Deluxe 功能包得最齊全，VPN 沒有流量上限，還附 50GB Windows 雲端備份、暗網監控跟 AI 詐騙偵測，同時也是這裡唯一把第二年價格直接寫在商品頁上的廠商，續約 124.99 美元，緊接在首年 49.99 美元後面。我把這份透明度算成加分，但實際成本這一欄還是給得低，因為促銷期一過就跳到 2.5 倍，就算你早就看到這個數字，這筆帳依然不划算，這正是這份排行榜想要揭穿的那種套路。

Microsoft Defender 拿下第四，理由很單純，它免費、本來就裝在你電腦裡，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月測試給了 6/5.5/6 的最佳產品評價。拿不到的是 VPN、密碼管理器跟家長監控，而且免費版只支援 Windows。

Kaspersky Premium 墊底，引擎技術本身沒問題，問題出在禁令。美國商務部對它的禁令在 2024 年 9 月 29 日全面生效，到這次排行為止依然有效，美國境內不能新簽合約、拿不到病毒碼更新，也沒有合法的客服支援。一款在你所在的國家已經合法拿不到最新病毒碼的資安軟體，不管禁令生效前的實驗室成績多漂亮，現在就是失去了資安軟體該有的功能。

highlights.body: AV-Comparatives 2025 年報告給 Bitdefender Top-Rated Product 獎，實測防護銀牌、惡意程式防護銅牌、進階威脅防護金牌（跟 ESET 並列），還有誤判防護銅牌，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月的 Windows 測試再補上滿分 6/6/6 加最佳產品。兩間跟廠商沒有利害關係的實驗室，在同一年給出一致的結論，這種份量行銷稿寫不出來。它唯一縮手的地方是內建 VPN，每台裝置每天只給 200MB，當成應急工具就好，別指望拿它常態掛著用。

highlights.body: 這份榜單裡大多數廠商根本不把第二年的價格放上頁面，讓你等到信用卡帳單來才知道。Norton 把話講在前面，360 Deluxe 的續約價 124.99 美元就寫在首年 49.99 美元旁邊。我把這份透明度算成 Norton 的加分項，實際成本這一欄還是給得低，因為促銷期一過就跳到 2.5 倍，就算你早就看到這個數字，這筆帳依然不划算。

highlights.title: McAfee 那組無限裝置 VPN，條款裡藏了一個陷阱
highlights.body: McAfee+ Premium 首年價格是這裡最低的，裝置數量也不限，兩個數字看起來都很漂亮。問題是 McAfee 自己的帳戶說明頁就寫著，那組無限流量 VPN 只有在你沒關掉自動續訂的時候才會一直有效，你為了躲開第二年漲價把自動續訂關掉，VPN 就悄悄縮回每月 500MB。這種設計等於在懲罰一個資安意識強的使用者本來就該做的事，也就是取消訂閱。

en.commentary:
No rank changes today, and a new data point makes the Kaspersky case even more interesting to write about honestly. AV-TEST's February 2026 cycle actually gave Kaspersky Premium a perfect 18 out of 18 for protection, performance and usability, which tells you the underlying engine has not degraded on a technical level. I am not moving it off tenth place, and the reason has nothing to do with lab scores. The US Commerce Department's prohibition, in effect since September 29, 2024, still blocks new sales, updates and support for American buyers, and that freeze means any new malware signature, phishing URL or exploit that emerged after the ban date never reaches a US install through the normal update channel. A perfect lab score measured on a version still receiving live updates elsewhere tells you nothing about the frozen copy sitting on an American machine.

Bitdefender keeps first on the same two-lab agreement I have cited all month, AV-Comparatives' Top-Rated Product award and AV-TEST's 6/6/6. ESET holds second as the only outright Product of the Year winner here. Norton's transparent but painful renewal jump keeps it third, and Microsoft Defender's free, built-in, lab-verified protection holds fourth.

If you are a US reader still running Kaspersky, the AV-TEST number is not a reason to relax. It measures a product you are not receiving. Move to a supported alternative on this list before your next renewal date, not after.

highlights.title: Kaspersky's lab score and its US reality point in opposite directions
highlights.body: AV-TEST's February 2026 cycle gave Kaspersky Premium a perfect 18 out of 18, proof the engine itself remains technically strong. That score was measured on a version still receiving live updates outside the United States. The US Commerce Department ban, in force since September 29, 2024, freezes updates for American installs, so a lab result from an actively maintained build tells a US user nothing about the frozen copy on their own machine.

highlights.title: Bitdefender's two-lab agreement still leads
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives' Top-Rated Product award and AV-TEST's perfect 6/6/6 come from labs with no stake in which vendor wins, and both point the same direction this month. That consistency is why it holds first over products with a single strong result.

highlights.title: ESET remains the only true Product of the Year winner here
highlights.body: The 2024 award was the outright top prize, not a shared or category medal, and the same engine keeps posting Top Product scores. Essential's tradeoff is a missing VPN and identity monitoring, the honest price of that focus.

highlights.title: US Kaspersky users should treat every day past the ban as borrowed time
highlights.body: New malware signatures, phishing URLs and exploits discovered after September 2024 never reach a frozen US install. A strong lab score measured elsewhere does not change that a US copy of Kaspersky is missing what keeps any antivirus useful, which is why it stays last on this list regardless of engine quality.

zh-tw.commentary:
今天排名不動，不過有一個新的數字讓 Kaspersky 這個案例更值得誠實講清楚。AV-TEST 2026 年 2 月的測試週期，其實給了 Kaspersky Premium 防護、效能、易用性滿分 18 分，代表引擎本身在技術面完全沒有退步。我還是把它留在第十名，理由跟實驗室成績一點關係都沒有。美國商務部的禁令從 2024 年 9 月 29 日生效到現在，依然封鎖美國買家的新銷售、更新跟客服支援，這代表禁令之後出現的任何新病毒特徵、釣魚網址或漏洞，都不會透過正常更新管道進到美國裝置裡。一款在其他地區還在正常更新的版本拿到滿分，跟美國那個被凍結的版本完全是兩回事。

Bitdefender 靠我這整個月一直在講的兩間實驗室共識守住第一，AV-Comparatives 的 Top-Rated Product 加 AV-TEST 的滿分 6/6/6。ESET 是這裡唯一真正拿下年度產品大獎的一款，守第二。Norton 續約價透明卻痛的特性讓它守第三，Microsoft Defender 免費內建又通過驗證，守第四。

如果你是還在用 Kaspersky 的美國讀者，這個實驗室分數只證明了引擎技術面，量的是你根本收不到的那個版本，換不了美國市場的現實。趁下次續約之前換到榜上有支援的替代品最實在。

highlights.title: Kaspersky 的實驗室分數跟美國現實是兩件事
highlights.body: AV-TEST 2026 年 2 月給 Kaspersky Premium 滿分 18 分，證明引擎技術面確實沒退步。這個分數量的是美國以外還在正常更新的版本。美國商務部禁令從 2024 年 9 月 29 日生效至今，凍結了美國裝置的更新，所以一款還在維護的版本拿到高分，說明不了美國那個被凍結版本的狀況。

highlights.title: Bitdefender 靠兩間實驗室的共識繼續領先
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives 的 Top-Rated Product 獎跟 AV-TEST 的滿分 6/6/6，是兩間跟廠商沒有利害關係的實驗室在同一個月給出一致結論，這種份量是單一亮眼成績比不上的，也是它守住第一的理由。

highlights.title: 美國 Kaspersky 使用者，禁令之後每多用一天都是在借時間
highlights.body: 2024 年 9 月之後出現的新病毒特徵、釣魚網址、漏洞，永遠不會進到被凍結的美國裝置裡。就算引擎在其他地方測出高分，也改變不了美國那個版本收不到讓防毒軟體有用的東西這個事實，這就是不管引擎多強，它都留在榜單最後一名的原因。

references.title: Test antivirus software for Windows 11, June 2026

en.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security keeps first place and ESET HOME Security Essential keeps second, and the newest lab data I can verify supports leaving the order alone. AV-TEST evaluated 16 home user security products for Windows 11 across May and June 2026, scoring each out of 6 points in protection, performance, and usability, for a best possible total of 18. That is the most recent full lab cycle I could find in this week's sources, and I did not see a newer public batch.

Why do I still put Bitdefender first? It pairs strong detection with a light footprint, so a laptop stays responsive during scans, and the suite covers the extras most households want in one subscription. ESET sits close behind with a clean interface and a reputation for low system impact, which suits older machines and anyone who dislikes pop-ups.

Norton 360 Deluxe at third brings the widest bundle of extras, and Microsoft Defender at fourth deserves respect as a free built-in option that already ships on every Windows PC. If you only need a solid baseline and you browse carefully, Defender is a legitimate choice.

My buying tip is to check the lab page for the specific product tier and the specific Windows version you use, because test results attach to particular versions. Renew only after comparing the current price with the new-customer price, since many vendors discount the first year steeply. Rankings are unchanged today.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security 續居第一，ESET HOME Security Essential 續居第二，我能查證到的最新實驗室資料，也支持維持現有順序。AV-TEST 在 2026 年 5 月與 6 月針對 Windows 11 測試了 16 款家用資安產品，每款在防護、效能、易用性三項各最高 6 分，總分最高 18 分。這是我在本週資料中找得到最新的完整測試週期，沒有看到更新的公開批次。

為什麼我還是把 Bitdefender 放第一？它把強大的偵測力和輕量的系統負擔放在一起，掃描時筆電依然順暢，套件也涵蓋大多數家庭想要的附加功能，一份訂閱就搞定。ESET 緊追在後，介面乾淨，系統占用低的口碑很好，適合老電腦，也適合討厭彈跳視窗的人。

第三名的 Norton 360 Deluxe 附加功能最多，第四名的 Microsoft Defender 是每台 Windows 電腦都內建的免費選項，值得尊重。如果你只要基本防護，平常上網也很小心，Defender 是個合理的選擇。

我的購買建議是，先到實驗室網站看你要買的方案等級和你的 Windows 版本，因為測試結果是對應特定版本的。續約前先比較目前價格和新客戶價格，很多廠商第一年折扣很大。台灣讀者也可以留意年底的週年慶與雙 11 檔期。今天排名不變。

en.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security keeps first place, and this week's sources give me one more data point to lean on. Coverage in September 2026 reports that AV-TEST gave Bitdefender Total Security 27.0 a perfect 18 out of 18 in June, and that Norton 360 earned the same perfect score. Two products at the ceiling is why I look at everything around the score: interface, performance impact, and how many devices the licence covers.

Bitdefender leads for me because it pairs top lab results with a light footprint and a clean interface that a non-technical family member can use without calling me. ESET HOME Security Essential holds second, and one roundup notes ESET ranks first in AV-Comparatives testing in 2026, which supports its place. Norton 360 Deluxe stays third as the best all-in-one bundle, with VPN and identity tools in one subscription.

Microsoft Defender is worth a mention too. AV-Comparatives Real-World Protection from February to May 2026 gave it 99.0 percent with zero false positives, so a free built-in tool now scores at a level that would have surprised me a few years ago. It sits fourth because the paid suites add extras that many households value.

Nothing in the last seven days changes the order, so every score stays. My advice is to buy on the three-year price only if you plan to stay, and to check the renewal price before you check out, since first-year discounts are where these suites make their margin.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security 繼續排第一，這週的資料又給了我一個可以倚靠的證據。九月的報導指出，AV-TEST 在 2026 年 6 月給 Bitdefender Total Security 27.0 滿分 18 分，Norton 360 同樣拿到滿分。兩套都摸到天花板，所以我更在意分數以外的東西，像是介面、對效能的影響，還有一份授權能顧幾台裝置。

Bitdefender 排第一，是因為它把頂級實驗室成績、輕巧的資源占用和乾淨的介面湊在一起，家裡不懂電腦的長輩自己就能操作，不用每次都打給我。ESET HOME Security Essential 穩居第二，有一篇整理文提到 ESET 在 2026 年 AV-Comparatives 測試中名列第一，這支持了它的位置。Norton 360 Deluxe 維持第三，一份訂閱就包含 VPN 和身分保護，是我心目中最完整的一站式方案。

另外要提 Microsoft Defender。AV-Comparatives 2026 年 2 月到 5 月的真實世界防護測試，給它 99.0% 的防護率，誤報為零。內建的免費工具能到這個水準，幾年前我真的想不到。它排第四，因為付費套件多了不少額外功能，很多家庭用得到。

過去七天沒有任何消息足以改變排序，所以分數全部照舊。買的時候有個小提醒：三年方案要確定自己會用滿再買，而且結帳前先看續約價，第一年的折扣往往就是這類軟體的利潤來源，這在台灣的年底促銷檔期特別常見。
